resolved_findings.problem: All controlled members cancelled before RPC completion could still unconditionally ingest a new body.
resolved_findings.resolution: Check active members at commit admission; preserve valid restrictive observations and refuse new body when none remain.
resolved_findings.verification: Independent all_cancel_no_orphan_commit and delivery_cancel_after_commit passed in Debug and ASan/UBSan.

resolved_findings.problem: Closing admission after an RPC exception incorrectly marked the physical RPC complete and suppressed last-member cooperation.
resolved_findings.resolution: Separate admission closure from reliable response receipt; unknown completion can still trigger one best-effort cancellation.
resolved_findings.verification: Independent uncertain_rpc_cooperation passed in Debug and ASan/UBSan with unknown usage and one cancel.

resolved_findings.problem: Late principal-revocation receipt preservation initially applied to every operation with a usage field.
resolved_findings.resolution: Restrict the new receipt behavior to web.read; preserve other operations original errors.
resolved_findings.verification: Final static source review; no separate independent deterministic Service end-check probe claimed.

resolved_findings.problem: An explicitly empty read_id silently became an uncontrolled MCP read.
resolved_findings.resolution: Only None omits the optional handle; explicit empty input reaches Core validation without a legacy retry.
resolved_findings.verification: Final static source review and final MCP implementation hash in worker-probe-v2-record.json; parent formal adapter tests are separate evidence.

resolved_findings.problem: Worker repeated cancellation reset the retired-control expiry despite the documented non-extension rule.
resolved_findings.resolution: Keep previous[0] for existing retired controls while preserving cancelled state and usage.
resolved_findings.verification: Exact single-expression delta checked; two author before/after expiry regressions reviewed and archived separately.

retained_unsuccessful_execution.detail: PermissionError occurred at socket creation before any independent RPC scenario executed; not counted as product test failure or pass.

scope_limits: Cancellation and successful member delivery are linearized; commit admission and Store commit intentionally do not share one held coordination lock, so cancellation does not promise rollback of a commit already admitted.
Payer cancellation acknowledgement does not imply the original synchronous payer call returns before its bounded physical attempt settles.
Core process handles and Worker retention are not a persistent execution or accounting journal; no restart recovery, automatic retry or exactly-once network guarantee is inferred.
Existing HTTP backpressure can reject cancellation before admission; there is no reserved control lane.
Cross-instance, cross-process and cross-channel sharing remain excluded. Complete B-24/CACHE-01, real-source approval, long-running failure and restoration acceptance remain unsigned.
Independent Debug and sanitizer repeats are the same 12 scenarios, not 24 new product acceptance cases. Worker and author regression counts must not be added to formal CTest suite counts.
provenance_notes: All reviewer writes are confined to this independent/ evidence directory. No repository branch, commit, production source, formal test, main build directory or existing validation record was changed by the reviewer.
